name: ANTONINO COLOSIMO
bioAdditions: Same burial entry as I282824815695 (7 January 1673) (S1): duplicate profile. He is the father of Antonio Colosimo (bapt. 15 Jun 1659, son of Antonino and Angila Vaccaro).
